S4.01.note: If an unsent draft is open, the panel shows "Send or clear your draft before leaving this unsent chat." instead of starting a new chat. The command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K) also has New chat.
steps: Open the AGI side panel while signed in.
Click the pen icon in the header whose tooltip and accessible name is New chat.
Look for an empty chat with the composer ready to type in.
S4.01.where: Side panel header > New chat (pen icon)

S4.02.needs: a signed-in account with at least one saved chat
S4.02.note: The command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K) > Search chats opens the same Recent chats list.
steps: Click the clock icon in the header to open Recent chats.
Click a chat title in the list.
Look for that chat's transcript and check that the composer lets you send a new message to continue it.
S4.02.where: Side panel header > Recent chats (clock icon)

S4.03.needs: a signed-in account with several saved chats
S4.03.note: The search field is in the Recent chats sheet, not a separate page. Code for matching titles and message text was not checked in detail.
steps: Click the clock icon in the header to open Recent chats.
Click the Search recent chats field and type a word from a past chat title or message.
Check that only matching past chats are listed.
Click one of them and check that its transcript opens.
S4.03.where: Side panel header > Recent chats (clock icon) > Search recent chats

S4.06.note: No Projects index screen found in apps/extension. Project choices appear only in the chat history menu (Move to project, Add to project) and as a Projects group when typing @ in the composer. Searched the locale file and src for Projects, project list and project keys.

S4.07.needs: a signed-in account with a project
S4.07.note: No project overview screen found in apps/extension. The only project element is the chip that reads "Project · NAME" with a clear button, shown after a project is selected. Searched the locale file and src for project keys.

S4.08.needs: a signed-in account with a project that has chats
S4.08.note: No list of project conversations found in apps/extension. Searched the locale file and src for project keys.

S4.10.needs: a signed-in account with a project
S4.10.note: No project instructions editor found in apps/extension. Searched the locale file for instruction and project keys and src for project screens.

S4.13.needs: a paid account with the AGI Work capability (a Free account sees a gated note instead)
S4.13.note: The button shows AI Assistant by default and the current model name after a model is chosen. The AGI Work switch appears only when the plan allows it.
steps: Click the AI Assistant button above the composer to open the model menu.
Turn on the AGI Work switch.
Type a goal in the composer and send it. Check that a multi-step AGI Work run starts.
Click More (...) > Tasks and check that the run appears in the list of recent work.
S4.13.where: AI Assistant button above the composer > AGI Work switch; recent work under More (...) > Tasks

S4.14.needs: a signed-in account with at least one running or finished task
S4.14.note: The Tasks sheet has no filter control in the code, so the Expected filter between active and finished tasks was not found. Only Stop appears on live tasks.
steps: Click More (...) in the header, then click Tasks.
Look at the list: each row shows a title, a state label and a time.
Check whether any finished tasks can be hidden or filtered out.
Click All tasks on the web at the bottom to compare the full list.

S4.15.needs: a signed-in account with a task that has a conversation
S4.15.note: The side panel shows only the title, state and time. Status, steps, outputs and pending decisions are expected on the web page, which the extension code does not show.
steps: Click More (...) in the header, then click Tasks.
Click Open on a task row.
Look for a new browser tab on the AGI web app at that task's chat.
S4.15.where: More (...) > Tasks > Open on a task row

S4.16.needs: a signed-in account with pending approvals
S4.16.note: No approvals inbox found in apps/extension. Approvals appear inside a chat (Approve / Decline) and in the Schedules list for paused steps (Approve / Deny). Searched the locale file and src for approval and inbox keys.

S4.17.note: The schedule manager sits inside the Shortcuts page of the options settings, not in its own destination. Schedule... in a chat's history menu opens the same page with a draft.
steps: Click More (...) in the header, then click Shortcuts. This opens the settings page on Shortcuts.
Scroll to the Schedules heading.
Click New schedule, fill in Name, Instructions and Repeat, then click Create schedule.
In the list, use Pause or Resume, Run now, Edit and Delete on a row, and check each result against Expected.

S4.18.needs: a schedule that has at least one run
S4.18.note: Cadence is not shown on the row or in the runs block. The Repeat setting is visible only in the create form, and it is hidden while editing.
steps: Open the Schedules section as in S4.17.
Click Runs on a schedule row.
Look for the Instructions text (shown under Prompt), the Next and Last times on the row, and the list of past runs under Runs.
S4.18.where: More (...) > Shortcuts > Schedules > a schedule row > Runs

S4.25.needs: a signed-in account with generated artifacts
S4.25.note: No artifact gallery found in apps/extension. Artifacts appear as cards inside a chat reply (Artifacts in this reply, with Open and Hide). Searched the locale file and src for gallery and artifact list keys.

S4.39.needs: a paid account (the Usage row is hidden on the Free plan)
S4.39.note: The extension shows only a percent meter. The per-window and reset detail is on the web page, which the extension code does not render. The web page content was not checked.
steps: Click More (...) in the header and read the Usage row, which shows a percent meter.
Click Usage. A new tab opens the AGI web usage page.
Compare the usage windows, reset times and history on that page with Expected.
S4.39.where: More (...) > Usage, or Options > Account > Plan and usage > Open

S4.41.note: More (...) > Settings opens the web settings page instead. The autofill profile is saved on this device, not in the account. The save button label for the profile was not checked.
steps: Click More (...) in the header, then click Extension settings. This opens the Permissions page.
Click Options in the left menu. Change a notification setting or the Theme under Appearance.
Click Account in the left menu and open Autofill profile (optional). Change a field and save it.
Reopen the page and check that the changes were kept.
S4.41.where: More (...) > Extension settings > Options (left menu); Account for the autofill profile

S4.44.note: No in-product feedback or bug report form was found in apps/extension, so that part of Expected is not met in the code. Searched the locale file and src for feedback and bug report text.
steps: Click More (...) in the header, then click Help. This opens the settings page on Help.
Check the Help center, Documentation and Contact support rows. Each has an Open link that opens the AGI web app in a new tab.
Look for a way to send product feedback or a bug report inside the product.
